question: Select the **INCORRECTLY** spelt word.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is '**Ingenuos**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given Options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Ingenuos**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Ingenuous**'.
 
• It means 'honest, innocent, and willing to trust people in a way that sometimes seems foolish'. (निष्‍कपट और सरल)
 
 
• *Example: It is **ingenuous** to suppose that money did not play a part in his decision.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Ingenuos.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Perfidy**: the state of being deceitful and untrustworthy. (धोखेबाज और अविश्वसनीय होने की स्थिति)
 
• **Misanthrope**: a person who hates or avoids other people. (मनुष्य से घृणा करनेवाला; मानवद्वेषी)
 
• **Relentless**: not stopping or changing. (लगातार, अनवरत, निरंतर)
